commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Ordinary awareness comes from the mind. The word by which the world says “he is this sort of man” comes from his company. Bare sense perception is natural and needs no group. Being called good or bad rests on a finer, acquired understanding, and that needs one. This answers those who won’t accept the water comparison and say that change also comes from the mind.
